normalization_scope: available measurements within each existing, financially eligible comparison group; never across incompatible evidence groups
missing_rule: unknown positive-weight input blocks the final score; no imputation or redistribution; explicit zero excludes only that dimension
equal_range_rule: relative min/max: 100 for all equal values, non-discriminating; absolute scales: identical values receive identical utility
tie_rule: reference position, then canonical academic ID; no invented distinction
coefficient_status: Declared project methodological choices, not empirically validated preferences or efficacy

total_cost.label: Combustível estimado no cenário
total_cost.limitation: Fuel only, not total ownership cost; PBEV or explicit user consumption and explicit compatible fuel price.

usage_fit.label: Compatibilidade documental com o perfil
usage_fit.formula: 100 only after the existing published and live profile gates pass
usage_fit.limitation: Entry condition, not a measured suitability score. All equally compatible vehicles receive 100; no ranking distinction.

comfort.label: Capacidade do porta-malas
comfort.limitation: Nominal documented luggage capacity, not comfort or measured passenger space. Source loading/configuration caveats remain attached.

safety.label: Inventário de equipamentos de segurança
safety.limitation: All three exact observations required; explicit absence is valid and scores less; unknown blocks. Not crash performance or equally safe vehicles.

performance.label: Relação massa/potência com gasolina
performance.limitation: Compatible exact-variant mass and nominal gasoline power only; not road handling, acceleration, or an ethanol-power estimate.

efficiency.label: Consumo combinado no cenário
efficiency.limitation: PBEV or explicitly supplied consumption, not measured individual real-world economy.

legacy_quality.label: Manutenção e desvalorização estimadas
legacy_quality.limitation: Sum of two scenario expenses, not historical reliability, parts availability or observed workshop/resale data. Rates unchanged; much of the differentiation may follow FIPE price.

dependencies: Fuel cost and efficiency share the same consumption evidence and route shares; they are not independent evidence.
Scenario maintenance/depreciation may depend on FIPE price; low price is not proof of reliability.
activation: Never changes methodology_ready, observed_tco_complete, operationally_active, recommended, snapshots, eligibility or Gold
